scope: new-tab heading fragments and stable virtualized navigation
failure: A new document tab dropped its fragment. After forwarding was corrected, initial range selection and viewport replacement/resize also displaced the destination.
implementation: Carry fragments through mobile and Mac tab callbacks.
Request a fragment range before the initial document can scroll.
Preserve visible reading offsets across range replacement and resize.
Retain pending destinations through two guarded animation frames for delayed WebKit native scroll updates.
Reset cached anchors when replacing or clearing a document.
regressionsFailedFirst: Native phone link action opened the file without reaching the section.
Renderer initial fragment range omitted the distant destination.
Replacing the viewport lost the visible block offset.
Resize used the reset browser offset instead of the previous reading offset.

native.testCorrection: XCTest queried an activation point for a noninteractive paragraph during layout. The final predicate requires its full frame inside the webview.
